nodes.description: Controller Governor struct holding funds, config and modules governor addresses; guards privileged setters.
Mapping of module ID to current module implementation address in Controller.
Mapping of module address to Module struct (id and disabled flag) in Controller.
Mapping of function signature to forwarding target used by the Controller fallback.
ACL roles mapping (roleId => address => bool) driving hasRole access checks.
CourtClock duration in seconds of each Court term.
CourtClock last ensured term id, incremented on heartbeat.
CourtConfig term id at which the next configuration change becomes effective.
CourtConfig mapping of term id to config id.
CourtConfig array of stored Config structs.
Controlled contract reference to the Controller, used for auth and module lookups.
Controlled mapping of module ID to linked module address written by linkModules.
PaymentsBook mapping of period id to Period struct holding shares and claim flags.
PaymentsBook duration of a payment period in Court terms.
PaymentsBook permyriad of collected payments allocated to the Court governor.
Controller payable fallback that forwards msg.data and msg.value to a registered custom function target.
Controller setConfig, onlyConfigGovernor, schedules a new Court configuration.
Controller delayStartTime, onlyConfigGovernor, delays the first term start time.
Controller changeFundsGovernor, onlyFundsGovernor, updates governor.funds.
Controller grant, onlyConfigGovernor, grants an ACL role.
Controller revoke, onlyConfigGovernor, revokes an ACL role.
Controller freeze, onlyConfigGovernor, freezes an ACL role.
Controller bulk, onlyConfigGovernor, enacts a batch of ACL operations.
Controller setModule, onlyModulesGovernor, registers a module implementation.
Controller setModules, onlyModulesGovernor, sets and links several modules at once.
Controller syncModuleLinks, onlyModulesGovernor, re-links connected modules.
Controller disableModule, onlyModulesGovernor, flags a module as disabled.
Controller enableModule, onlyModulesGovernor, re-enables a disabled module.
Controller setCustomFunction, onlyModulesGovernor, sets the forward target for a signature.
Controller internal _setModule, validates the address is a contract and writes module registries.
Controller internal _syncModuleLinks, resolves module addresses and performs external linkModules calls.
ACL internal _grant, writes roles mapping after frozen checks.
ACL internal _revoke, clears roles mapping after frozen checks.
ACL internal _freeze, sets the freeze flag for a role.
ACL internal _bulk, loops over batched ACL operations and dispatches them.
CourtClock internal _heartbeat, transitions terms computing start times and randomness block numbers.
ControlledRecoverable recoverFunds, onlyFundsGovernor, sweeps ETH or ERC20 tokens to an arbitrary recipient.
PaymentsBook pay, payable entrypoint splitting a payment into governor and guardian shares and depositing funds.
PaymentsBook claimGuardianShare, authenticateSender guarded, computes and transfers guardian shares.
PaymentsBook claimGovernorShare, transfers the governor share for a past period.
PaymentsBook internal _claimGuardianShare, marks claimed and transfers the guardian amount.
PaymentsBook internal _claimGovernorShare, marks claimed and transfers the governor amount.
PaymentsBook internal _deposit, pulls ETH or ERC20 tokens from the payer.
PaymentsBook internal _transfer, sends ETH with send() or ERC20 with safeTransfer.
PaymentsBook internal _ensurePeriodBalanceDetails, computes and caches period balance checkpoint and total active balance.
Controlled linkModules, onlyController, writes linkedModules addresses for a list of module IDs.
PaymentsBook setGovernorSharePct, onlyConfigGovernor, updates the governor share permyriad.
CourtClock internal _ensureCurrentTerm, bounds the number of auto transitions then calls _heartbeat.
SafeERC20 private invokeAndCheckSuccess, performs an assembly call to the token and inspects the return data.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used in every modifier and authentication check.
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time source feeding term transition math.
tx.origin, origin-controlled address (not used for authorization in the analyzed paths).
Low-level address(target).call.value(msg.value)(msg.data) forwarding arbitrary calldata in the fallback.
Assembly call( gas, _addr, 0, ... ) executing an arbitrary calldata payload in SafeERC20.
_to.send(balance) ETH transfer to an arbitrary payable recipient inside recoverFunds.
_to.send(_amount) ETH transfer to an arbitrary payable recipient inside PaymentsBook._transfer.
IModulesLinker(_modulesToBeSynced[j]).linkModules(...) untrusted external call from the Controller.
IERC20(_token).safeTransferFrom(_from, address(this), _amount) pulling arbitrary ERC20 funds.
IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(_to, _amount) sending ERC20 funds to a recipient.
Parameter _target of setCustomFunction, the forwarding implementation address.
Parameter _addr of setModule, the module implementation address to register.
Parameter _newFundsGovernor of changeFundsGovernor.
Parameter payable _guardian of claimGuardianShare, the account shares are transferred to.
Parameter _tokens list of claimGuardianShare, iterated to claim each token share.
Parameter _periodId of claimGuardianShare, selects the payments period storage slot.
Local variable target in fallback, holds the custom function target address.
Local variable governorShare in pay, computed via PctHelpers.pct.
Local variable guardiansShare in pay, computed via SafeMath.sub.
Local variable amount in _claimGuardianShare, the computed guardian payout.
Local variable moduleAddress in _syncModuleLinks, resolved module implementation address.

edges.reason: msg.sender reaches the fallback and its msg.data is forwarded to the custom function target.
fallback reads customFunctions[msg.sig] to resolve the forwarding target.
local target is assigned from the customFunctions mapping lookup.
fallback executes the low-level call forwarding msg.value and msg.data.
local target is used as the destination address of the low-level call.
setCustomFunction writes the customFunctions mapping used by the fallback.
onlyModulesGovernor requires msg.sender == governor.modules before allowing target registration.
changeFundsGovernor reads and updates the governor.funds field.
onlyFundsGovernor compares msg.sender against governor.funds.
changeFundsGovernor writes the new funds governor into storage.
setModule delegates to internal _setModule.
setModules loops and calls _setModule for each new module.
setModules calls _syncModuleLinks to re-link new and existing modules.
syncModuleLinks delegates to internal _syncModuleLinks.
_syncModuleLinks performs an external call to each module's linkModules function.
the externally called module executes linkModules, invoked only when msg.sender is the controller.
linkModules writes the linkedModules mapping that other modules rely on for trust.
onlyController checks that msg.sender equals the stored controller address.
msg.sender is validated against the controller reference in the onlyController modifier.
local moduleAddress resolved in the loop is stored into the addressesToBeSet array.
_setModule stores the address in currentModules.
_setModule stores the id in allModules for the given address.
parameter _addr flows into the module registry write.
grant delegates to internal ACL _grant.
revoke delegates to internal ACL _revoke.
freeze delegates to internal ACL _freeze.
bulk delegates to internal ACL _bulk.
_grant sets roles[_id][_who] to true, expanding privileges.
_revoke clears roles[_id][_who], removing privileges.
_freeze writes roles[_id][FREEZE_FLAG] permanently freezing a role.
_bulk dispatches BulkOp.Grant entries to _grant.
_bulk dispatches BulkOp.Revoke entries to _revoke.
_bulk dispatches BulkOp.Freeze entries to _freeze.
hasRole/roles mapping determines whether a caller holds the role required for privileged operations.
the roles mapping gates revoke-style role management paths.
onlyConfigGovernor checks msg.sender before executing a bulk ACL update.
onlyConfigGovernor checks msg.sender before granting a role.
onlyModulesGovernor checks msg.sender before syncing module links.
block.timestamp derived time determines how many terms must be transitioned in _heartbeat.
_ensureCurrentTerm calls _heartbeat when transitions are pending.
_heartbeat writes the new termId after processing transitions.
term start time is computed with SafeMath64 add of termDuration during transitions.
setConfig schedules configChangeTermId, the term from which new parameters apply.
pay reads governorSharePct to compute the governor's cut of the payment.
local governorShare is derived using PctHelpers.pct multiplication and division.
local guardiansShare is derived using SafeMath.sub of the governor share.
pay accumulates governor and guardian shares into the periods storage mappings.
pay calls _deposit to pull the funds into the contracts.
_deposit executes safeTransferFrom for ERC20 payments.
claimGuardianShare ensures the period balance details before computing shares.
claimGuardianShare calls _claimGuardianShare per token.
claimGovernorShare calls _claimGovernorShare per token.
authenticateSender(_guardian) allows msg.sender to claim on behalf of a guardian if authorized.
parameter _guardian is used both for the authorization check and as the transfer recipient.
parameter _tokens is iterated to compute and claim each token share.
parameter _periodId selects the Period storage slot being claimed.
_claimGuardianShare transfers the ERC20 amount to the guardian.
_claimGovernorShare transfers the ERC20 amount to the governor.
local amount flows from _getGuardianShare into the transfer executed by _claimGuardianShare.
ERC20 safeTransfer to an attacker-controlled guardian can re-enter claimGuardianShare before the claim flag is fully settled.
ETH send in _transfer invokes the guardian recipient and may re-enter the claims flow.
recoverFunds executes a send of the whole ETH balance to the recipient.
send to an arbitrary payable recipient can re-enter recoverFunds and repeat the sweep.
_ensurePeriodBalanceDetails caches balanceCheckpoint and totalActiveBalance into the Period.
periodDuration is used in the modulo computation that selects the random checkpoint term.
setGovernorSharePct is the only path that updates governorSharePct, guarded by onlyConfigGovernor.
onlyConfigGovernor compares msg.sender against the controller's config governor.
_transfer uses send() for the ETH branch.
_transfer uses safeTransfer for the ERC20 branch.
block.timestamp/blockhash based randomness drives the balance checkpoint selection in _ensurePeriodBalanceDetails.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _target only configures the forwarding target consumed by setCustomFunction and the fallback.
Parameter _addr is only used to register a module implementation in setModule.
Parameter _newFundsGovernor is only written into the governor struct by changeFundsGovernor.
Parameter _guardian supplies both the authorization subject and the transfer recipient of claimGuardianShare.
Parameter _tokens is only iterated inside claimGuardianShare to select claimed tokens.
Parameter _periodId only indexes the periods mapping read by claimGuardianShare.
Local target exists only to hold the customFunctions lookup result used by the fallback call.
Local governorShare is a transient intermediate of the share split performed by pay.
Local guardiansShare is a transient intermediate of the share split performed by pay.
Local amount is computed and immediately forwarded to the transfer inside _claimGuardianShare.
Local moduleAddress only holds the resolved module address used by the external linkModules call.
